== Biography ==
Christened 26 Feb 1670 in Linlithgow, to John Glasgow and Agnes Eastone<ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RK-NG6 : 16 September 2021), John Glasgow, 1671.</ref>
== Research Notes ==
=== Parish household review, 23 October 2026 ===

[[Glasgow-1929|Hugh Glasgow]] → [[Glasgow-1927|John Glasgow]]: 93% → 62% (probable). The adult Hugh/Margaret household is established by the 1732 Kilmarnock marriage and later children. Hugh’s 1710 Kilwinning baptism, OPR 599/1 p.70, names John Glasgow and Mary Gemmill; its recorded-child parent clause retains 93% conditional confidence. A 1710 birth permits marriage at 22 and Ann’s baptism at 39, and regional proximity supports continuity. None of the held adult records names his parents or connects the glover’s occupation with the Kilwinning child, so the complete adult-to-John-1927 relationship is assessed 62%. This corrects the scope of the displayed ancestral edge; it is not new evidence contradicting the 1710 parent clause. The conditional 93% remains in history. Ann’s 96% adult-household father identification cannot establish Hugh’s childhood ancestry. Mary Gemmill’s maternity depends on the same separate lifetime identity and is not reassessed automatically. Original register images uninspected.

Earlier dated percentages and interpretations below are retained as superseded history for these pairs; the current assessments and their specific identity limits are stated here. No live WikiTree changes have been made by this local review.

=== Father confidence review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1105]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The Linlithgow1671 transcript names John Glasgow and Agnes Eastone as the child John’s parents. John-1105 is the maintained father of that same named couple and parish child sequence. Exact parental pairing and parish identify the recorded family despite the unresolved day-of-February discrepancy.

The1671 Linlithgow child and John/Agnes Eastone household. This does not identify the child with the later Kilwinning father;2/26February and1670/1671 variants remain visible. Original uninspected.

Next useful test: The high-yield unresolved question is Linlithgow-child to Kilwinning-adult continuity.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RK-NG6 "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1RK-NG6 : 16 September 2021), John Glasgow, 1671.]. No new original was inspected in this review. This is an assessment of an existing attachment, not a new father.



=== Supplied parish index comparison ===

The supplied Scotland’s People index records '''JOHN GLASGOW''' on '''26/02/1671''' at Linlithgow, with parent text “JOHN GLASGOW/AGNES EASTONE FR779 (FR779)”.<ref name="OPRBirth035">Scotland’s People, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Old Parish Registers, births and baptisms], exact surname Glasgow through 1700, index text supplied 10 September 2026: JOHN GLASGOW, 26/02/1671, JOHN GLASGOW/AGNES EASTONE FR779 (FR779), indexed gender M, Linlithgow, parish 668, reference 20 / 281. Original register image not inspected for this review.</ref>

The profile’s structured birth date is 1671-02-02, whereas this index date is 1671-02-26. The two dates remain unreconciled. The combined births and baptisms collection does not establish whether the indexed date is a birthday or a baptism date. The biography’s existing christening statement gives 26 February 1670; the supplied index gives 1671. This year discrepancy also remains unresolved.
